events.title: Zissel Kassel – Fest an der Fulda (100 Jahre)
events.description: North Hessen's largest local and water festival celebrates its 100th anniversary under the motto '100 Years of Fun by the River'. Along the Fulda there are processions, a water-ski show, the dragon-boat cup and a land-and-water festival procession over four days. Rides, live music and festival tents provide fun for the whole family.

events.title: Open Flair Festival Eschwege
events.description: One of Hessen's biggest open-air music festivals, held right in the centre of Eschwege. The programme blends rock, pop and indie with street theatre, a kids' programme and performances. In addition to concerts on several stages there is a campsite and a diverse supporting programme.

events.title: Bad Hersfelder Festspiele: Something Rotten!
events.description: The cult Broadway musical 'Something Rotten!' celebrates its German-language premiere at the 75th Bad Hersfelder Festspiele in the unique Stiftsruine. The witty, slapstick-rich piece tells the story of two Shakespeare rivals in the 16th century. One of six main productions of the anniversary year.

events.title: Bad Nauheim Sommerreihe Jazz Night
events.description: The Bad Nauheim Sommerreihe presents a special jazz night at the historic Trinkkuranlage. A renowned guest artist performs smooth jazz, bossa nova, and contemporary standards. The Art Nouveau architecture and park setting provide an elegant concert backdrop. Audiences are encouraged to arrive early for good lawn spots and sunset views. Food and regional wine are available for purchase during the concert. Tickets start at 27 Euro from the Bad Nauheim cultural office.

events.title: Rheingau Musik Festival: Hayato Sumino & Aurora Orchestra
events.description: Artist-in-Residence Hayato Sumino performs with the Aurora Orchestra under Nicholas Collon in Wiesbaden's Kurhaus. The concert is part of the Rheingau Musik Festival, which presents over 170 concerts across the region in 2026. A mix of classical and contemporary music in an elegant setting.

events.title: Hanauer Weinfest im Schlossgarten
events.description: The Hanau wine festival turns the Schlossgarten into a wine village of Franconian wineries. For four days, fine Franconian wines such as Scheurebe and Weißburgunder are poured in the shade of old trees. Live music and regional treats complete the free-entry evenings.

events.title: Eschborn Kultursommer — Open Air World Music
events.description: Eschborn's Kultursommer presents a world music open air at the historic Museumshof. Artists perform traditional and contemporary music from Africa, Latin America, Asia, and Europe. The half-timbered courtyard provides a charming setting for the international program. International food stalls complement the musical journey around the globe. Free entry makes this accessible to all residents of Eschborn. The concert is weather-dependent with a rain alternative location.

events.title: Rheingau Musik Festival: Crown and Glory — VOCES8
events.description: The acclaimed vocal ensemble VOCES8 performs Crown and Glory at the Rheingau Musik Festival. The program features a cappella masterworks from the Renaissance to contemporary compositions. The Friedrich-von-Thiersch-Saal provides exceptional acoustics for this evening of vocal virtuosity. A pre-concert talk offers insights into the program and artistic journey. Tickets range from 28 to 48 Euro. The Rheingau Musik Festival runs through September 5.

events.title: Rheingau Musik Festival: Kloster Eberbach Basilika-Konzert
events.description: In the historic basilica of Kloster Eberbach, the Rheingau Musik Festival presents choral-symphonic works in the unique Romanesque monastery architecture of the UNESCO World Heritage site. One of the flagship concerts of the 2026 festival season.

events.title: Darmstadt Science Summer — Family Discovery Day
events.description: The Darmstadt Science Summer offers a family-friendly day of hands-on science experiments at the Wissenschaftsstadt. Interactive exhibits range from chemistry and physics to robotics and space exploration. The TU Darmstadt presents its latest research projects in accessible ways for all ages. Highlights include a planetarium show, robotics workshop, and live science demonstrations. The event encourages young people to explore careers in science and technology. Entry is free with some workshops requiring advance registration.

events.title: Rheingau Musik Festival: Jazz Night mit Hayato Sumino
events.description: Japanese piano sensation Hayato Sumino, the Artist in Residence of the 2026 Rheingau Musik Festival, presents a special jazz concert blending classical, jazz, and his own compositions. Sumino is renowned for his extraordinary versatility, moving seamlessly between classical piano repertoire, jazz improvisation, and contemporary compositions. The concert takes place at the Kurhaus Wiesbaden's Friedrich-von-Thiersch-Saal, celebrated for its exceptional acoustics and elegant Art Nouveau architecture. As Artist in Residence, Sumino performs seven concerts throughout the festival, showcasing his complete musical range. The Rheingau Musik Festival runs from June 20 to September 5, 2026, with 158 concerts at 26 venues. Tickets range from €28 to €58 and include a complimentary glass of sparkling wine during intermission.

events.title: Kultur.findet.Stadt — Open Air Festival im Museumshof Fulda
events.description: Kultur.findet.Stadt transforms the historic Museumshof in Fulda into a premier open-air festival venue from August 13-30, 2026. The program features an eclectic mix of artists including Dick Brave, Gentleman, ClockClock, Betterov, and Mittelalter-Rock and Heavy Metal acts. The Museumshof, set within Fulda's baroque old town, provides an intimate courtyard setting with exceptional acoustics and a charming historic atmosphere. Each evening features a different headliner, allowing visitors to choose from genres spanning pop, reggae, rock, and indie music. Food and drink stalls offer regional specialties and festival classics, with the historic surroundings creating a unique concert-going experience. Tickets range from €25 to €55 per concert and are available through Eventim and the Fulda tourist information office.
events.location: Museumshof Fulda, Unterm Heilig Kreuz, 36037 Fulda

events.title: Rüdesheimer Weinfest – Summer of Riesling
events.description: Around 13 Rheingau winemakers present over 200 wines at the Rüdesheim Summer of Riesling on the market square. In the spotlight are young Riesling, silky Pinot Noir and rarities in a festive summer-night atmosphere with live music. Gastronomic highlights and the traditional 'Rheinischer Abend' round it off.
events.cost_per_person: Free entry; wine by the glass from ~4 EUR

events.title: Wiesbaden Wine Tasting Evening
events.description: Experience finest Rheingau wines at a wine tasting event in Wiesbaden's historic city center. Local vintners present their award-winning Rieslings and Spätburgunders for tasting. Sommeliers guide visitors through flavor profiles and explain the Rheingau terroir. Regional cheese and charcuterie boards accompany the wines for a complete culinary experience. Live acoustic jazz provides a sophisticated backdrop to the evening. Tickets are 35 Euro per person including tastings and food pairings.

events.title: European Elvis Festival Bad Nauheim
events.description: At the 24th European Elvis Festival, fans from around the world celebrate the idol with petticoats and Elvis quiffs. Highlights include the open-air concert with Dick Brave, the 'Memories of Elvis' late-night show, and a classic-car parade with Cadillacs. A fan market and tours of authentic Elvis locations in Bad Nauheim round out the programme.

events.title: Rheingauer Weinwoche Wiesbaden
events.description: The 'longest wine counter in the world' turns Wiesbaden's Schlossplatz, Marktkirche and the Dern'sche Gelände into a Riesling stronghold for ten days. Over 100 stands offer nearly 1,000 wines and sparkling wines from the Rheingau. Opening on Friday with regional wine queens, plus live music and gastronomy.
events.cost_per_person: Free entry; tasting glass coupons from ~5 EUR

events.title: Marburger Sommernächte & Uni-Stadt Kultur
events.description: Marburg, the university city on the Lahn, offers a full summer programme of open-air concerts, theatre and cultural nights at venues such as the Schlossparkbühne and the Elisabethkirche. In August, singer-songwriter evenings and classical nights follow one another. Check the local events calendar for exact dates and line-ups.

events.title: Gießener Kultursommer: James Arthur
events.description: British singer-songwriter James Arthur (hits like 'Say You Won't Let Go') plays an open-air concert at Kloster Schiffenberg. With the unique evening backdrop over Giessen, an emotional pop and R&B evening awaits the audience. One of the international highlights of the Giessen Kultursommer 2026.

events.title: Stadtfest Fulda
events.description: For four days the Fulda city centre becomes a great festival mile with live music, shows, special actions and gastronomy. The most important self-organised event of the cathedral city pulls crowds into the old town, linking several stages with a programme for all generations. Free entry.

events.title: Limburg Altstadt & Domfestspiele Sommer
events.description: The medieval old town of Limburg an der Lahn hosts its summer city festival and the Weilburger Schlosskonzerte open-air classics nearby. Evening concerts, guided old-town walks and half-timbered charm make Limburg a lovely day trip. Live brass and chamber music against the backdrop of the famous cathedral.
events.location: Altstadt & Domberg, 65549 Limburg an der Lahn

events.title: Gießener Kultursommer: DONOTS & H-BLOCKX
events.description: Punk-rock legend Donots meet hip-hop and punk crossover band H-Blockx in a joint summer show at Kloster Schiffenberg. The evening promises to be loud, emotional and passionate. One of the most energetic dates of the Giessen Kultursommer 2026.

events.title: Gießener Kultursommer: Howard Carpendale
events.description: Schlager star Howard Carpendale performs at the Giessen Kultursommer in the open-air setting of Kloster Schiffenberg. The audience favourite presents his greatest hits from several decades of German music history. A atmospheric open-air evening.

events.title: Gießener Kultursommer: Nena
events.description: Neue Deutsche Welle icon Nena gives an open-air concert at Kloster Schiffenberg as part of the Giessen Kultursommer. Classics like '99 Luftballons' and 'Irgendwie, irgendwo, irgendwann' are part of the programme of one of Germany's most successful female singers.

events.title: Gießener Kultursommer: Amy Macdonald
events.description: Scottish singer-songwriter Amy Macdonald, famous for 'This Is the Life' and 'Mr Rock & Roll', plays an open-air concert at Kloster Schiffenberg. Her folk-rock sound in an intimate open-air setting promises a atmospheric summer evening. Part of the Giessen Kultursommer 2026 line-up.

events.title: Weinfest Fulda im Schlosshof
events.description: The Fulda wine festival turns the historic Schlosshof of the baroque residence into a delightful wine village with wines from the best sites. Daily rotating live bands provide entertainment on the warm summer evenings. A large selection of quality wines from white to red to rosé.
events.cost_per_person: Free entry; wine by the glass from ~4 EUR

events.title: Rheingau Literatur Festival 'WeinLese'
events.description: The Rheingau WeinLese literature festival unites contemporary literature with the wine region around Wiesbaden. Renowned authors read in idyllic venues such as wineries, village halls and castles. The first week runs 27-30 August 2026, a second follows in late September.

events.title: Darmstadt Heinerfest & Mathildenhöhe Herbst
events.description: Darmstadt's UNESCO World Heritage Mathildenhöhe and the city centre host a rich autumn programme of exhibitions, artists' open days and the traditional Heinerfest in late summer. The famous Art Nouveau artists' colony and exhibition buildings are a must-see. Multiple free and ticketed events across the season.

events.title: Gießener Kultursommer: Wincent Weiss
events.description: Pop singer Wincent Weiss performs at the Giessen Kultursommer at Kloster Schiffenberg. The German radio megastar presents his heartfelt pop songs in the unique open-air setting. With an additional extra show on 31 August he closes the 2026 festival programme.

events.title: Wetzlarer Brückenfest & Brückenlauf
events.description: The three-day Wetzlar city festival around the historic Lahn bridges offers music, entertainment and a shopping Sunday. The kick-off is the 25th Wetzlar Bridge Run on Friday. Various acts play on stages at the Colchester-Anlage, Eisenmarkt and Schillerplatz.

events.title: Herbstzauber in der Karlsaue Kassel
events.description: The 'Herbstzauber' in the Karlsaue shows autumn colours, plants, rarities and beautiful things for home and garden. On the flower island Siebenbergen and along the park paths, exhibitors present their autumn wares. A popular destination for garden lovers and families in Kassel.

events.title: Bergsträßer Winzerfest Bensheim
events.description: The largest wine festival in Southern Hessen lures around 100,000 visitors to the historic old town of Bensheim. Around 160 wines from all Bergstrasse vineyard sites can be tasted at winemakers' stands on the market square and in the alleys. Live music and regional specialities complement the nine-day festival.
events.cost_per_person: Free entry; wine tasting from ~3 EUR

events.title: Rheingau Musik Festival – Saisonfinale Kloster Eberbach
events.description: With a concert in the basilica of Kloster Eberbach, the Rheingau Musik Festival 2026 comes to a grand close after presenting 158 concerts at 26 venues since July. Choral symphonic and orchestral sound form the spectacular finale in the impressive monastery architecture. One of the season's most coveted tickets.
events.location: Kloster Eberbach Basilika, 65346 Eltville am Rhein

events.title: Beleuchtete Wasserspiele im Bergpark Wilhelmshöhe
events.description: At the illuminated water displays, the water flows in atmospheric lighting over cascades, the devil's bridge, aqueduct and the Jussow temple in the UNESCO World Heritage Bergpark Wilhelmshöhe. A supporting programme of lighting and music accompanies the staging. The evenings on 11 and 12 September 2026 are highlights of the Kassel events calendar.

events.title: Odenwald & Taunus: Kelterfeste und Herbstmärkte
events.description: Across the Odenwald and Taunus regions, September and October bring traditional Kelterfeste (cider festivals) and autumn markets. Local orchards press fresh apple cider and distilleries open their doors, while village fairs celebrate the harvest with regional food and folk music. A charming taste of rural Hessen.
events.cost_per_person: Free entry; food & drink from ~5 EUR
